home.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
home.when: home: a new person's one button (Create a knowledge base); otherwise my bases, builds running, my recent questions, pins due for review, the Archivist's last note; a curator's gaps and thumbs-down this week; the admin's usage, failed builds, pending dispatches and open proposals

activity.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
activity.when: my own activity trail, or a record's history

notifications.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
notifications.when: what the bell holds, and to mark it read

settings.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
settings.when: how I am told: email, texts, which kinds, my time zone

tokens.section: Home, me and the shell (Phase 2 and slice 9)
tokens.when: my own MCP tokens: mint one, revoke one

base-list.when: the bases I may read as cards: status, visibility, my level, sources and sections, last built, needs a rebuild

base-add.when: to make a knowledge base: a name and a template, done

base-view.when: a base at a glance: description, counts, areas, the last build, the curators, an ask box; an empty base's first action is Add documents

base-edit.when: to change a base's name, key, description or template (the template only while it is empty)

base-share.when: who may read or curate a base and why; share with a person, an agent, a department, a guest or an application; make it internal

base-settings.when: a base's auto-extract, sensitivity, language and monthly text limit

admin-settings.when: the application's settings, limits and retention, each its own form

templates.when: the templates and the guidelines each ships, read-only

sources.section: Sources and sectioning — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
sources.when: a base's sources as cards: kind, status, sections, pages, areas, stale or failed or no text

source-add.section: Sources and sectioning — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
source-add.when: to add documents: drop many files, paste text or add a page by its address

source-view.section: Sources and sectioning — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
source-view.when: one source: origin, status and its error in words, the outline, the pages, its areas, what it taught the graph; edit, replace, remove, retry

source-edit.section: Sources and sectioning — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
source-edit.when: to change a source's title or language

source-replace.section: Sources and sectioning — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
source-replace.when: to replace a source with a new version: its sections are forgotten and the new one is read afresh, its areas kept

section-view.section: Sources and sectioning — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR (slice 2)
section-view.when: one section: its heading path, its words, its page, previous and next; a citation's quote marked

guidelines.when: a base's guidelines by the five kinds, the version the graph is built under, what needs a rebuild

guideline-add.when: to write a guideline beside its kind's examples and preview it on a section

guideline-edit.when: to change a guideline and preview it on a section

guideline-view.when: a guideline's versions and the one the graph was built under

guidelines-compiled.when: what the engine is told: the compiled extraction prompt, the answer guidelines, the terms

vocabulary.when: a base's terms, aliases and types, alias conflicts and the terms the graph never met

term-add.when: to add a vocabulary term with its aliases and type

term-edit.when: to change or delete a vocabulary term

vocabulary-import.when: to import terms from a CSV: check first, then import

areas.when: a base's focus areas as cards; the proposed ones to accept or dismiss; sources in no area and areas with no source

area-add.when: to name a focus area: description, seed terms, example questions

area-view.when: one focus area: its terms, example questions, sources and its engine link

builds.when: what a build would do now against the month's limit, start it, rebuild everything, the builds so far

build-view.when: one build's progress, counts, usage, failed sections with their reasons, the items; cancel

ask.when: to ask a base a question and get an answer with citations that open their sections, or a plain nothing on this

question-view.when: one question in full: the answer, its citations, the evidence, the feedback, pin or unpin

questions.when: the base's question log for curators: who or which key asked, answered or not, rated how

gaps.when: what the base could not answer, clustered, and the thumbs-down answers

pinned.when: the pinned answers across my bases and which are due for review

graph.when: a base's graph: its size, the most connected subjects, communities when MaluDB has them, surprising links, a search; a curator's duplicates

subject-view.when: one subject: its statements, neighbours and the sections behind it; ask about it

path.when: how two subjects are related inside the base

keys.section: The token API, keys and K7 (slice 7)
keys.when: a base's API keys: label, area, limits, today's count, last use; mint, edit, rotate, revoke

key-add.section: The token API, keys and K7 (slice 7)
key-add.when: to mint an API key for a base: label, area, limits

key-edit.section: The token API, keys and K7 (slice 7)
key-edit.when: to change a key's label, area or limits

connections.section: The token API, keys and K7 (slice 7)
connections.when: which sibling applications read which bases, the shares and the reads, the last share calls (K26 built 2026-10-06: the kernel names the consumer in `X-OS-Consumer`)

proposals.when: the Archivist's proposals for a base: accept with its effect or dismiss

feeds.when: the feeds a base follows from sibling applications and how each last synced

feed-add.when: to follow a feed: a Spaces space or Help Desk's published articles

feed-edit.when: to change a feed's arguments, area, interval or whether it is enabled

dispatches.when: every request to the agents: pending, answered, refused, failed; retry a failed one

admin.when: the admin area: settings, templates, the model, usage, every base, every key, the agents, connections, proposals, dispatches, purge

admin-purge.when: to purge questions older than N days now, after seeing how many would go

admin-model.when: the engine's model and embedding model, its health, a base's namespace; change the model; test a base's prompt on a section

admin-usage.when: the text extracted and the engine calls by base and kind for a month

admin-bases.when: every base, the private ones marked (opening one logs the admin's look)

admin-keys.when: every API key of every base; revoke

admin-agents.when: the agents this application declares, the agent members here, which is the expert and which the Archivist, their dispatches
